provenance.source_title: Your Life After Faking Your Own Death

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（命运档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个不带感情宣读你命运档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，像在你耳边平静地念出你每一级的下场；用词具体到物件（红字、走廊灯、成扎的现金），情绪全部交给画面和事实自己发力；绝不评判你，但每一句平静都是量刑
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：不是「给你讲一个故事」，而是「这就是你将过的人生」，距离近到不适
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自细节的可信（调查流程、规程、案例）与预言式的确定语气，而非数据来源

tone_profile.certainty_style: 全部用确定语气陈述未来（You will / It feels like），判词简短如判；不写「也许这会后悔」式的模糊

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均8.3词，短句占59%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 制造冷静旁白的压迫感与宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 物证清单代替情绪形容词（红字账单/最后通知/不拆的信封）
rhythm_rules.function: 让读者自己从物件推出情绪

rhythm_rules.rule: 平行三叠句式（Somewhere behind you... ×3 / 选项清点 ×3）
rhythm_rules.function: 把同时发生的代价叠成一面墙

rhythm_rules.rule: 情绪峰值后用平静短句落地（You do not send it. / Then you turn the car around.）
rhythm_rules.function: 克制放大重锤，不给观众缓冲

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [绰号]），绰号即命运预告
rhythm_rules.function: 提供阶梯式方向感与宿命感

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（Dead men do not owe money to anyone.）
关键否定单独落下（You do not send it.）
章节卡后接场景定格（Level X → 你几岁/你在哪）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level two, the planner.）
时间跳转声明（Years pass the way years do.）
计划外事件转折（Then your wife does something you never planned for.）
循环回收（Somewhere right now another man is sitting at a kitchen table...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：全片几乎无幽默，仅一两处苦味反讽
placement_rules: 旧技能在新人生的苦味用法（Construction of all the bitter things.）
「负责任的事、父亲该做的事」式反讽标记
avoid_rules: 绝不使用玩笑或俏皮话
情绪重锤段落前后保持绝对严肃

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
You sit at your kitchen table at 2:00 in the morning. The house is quiet.
language_patterns.purpose: 用时间/地点/安静三要素定住氛围

language_patterns.formula: In front of you are the bills, red ink, final notices, a stack of envelopes...
language_patterns.purpose: 用物件代替情绪形容词

language_patterns.formula: Dead men do not owe money... Dead men are worth $X to...
language_patterns.purpose: 让禁忌念头显得像冷静算术

language_patterns.formula: It feels like a door opening in a wall you thought was solid.
language_patterns.purpose: 把主动选择改写成被动降临

language_patterns.formula: You do not learn from the ones who succeeded. The ones who succeeded, you never hear about.
language_patterns.purpose: 用幸存者偏差反转立方法论

language_patterns.formula: You tell yourself it is a gift. ... You almost believe it.
language_patterns.purpose: 标记角色的自我合理化并埋下动摇

language_patterns.formula: Somewhere behind you, the Coast Guard drags the water. Somewhere behind you, ...
language_patterns.purpose: 把同时发生的代价叠成一面墙

language_patterns.formula: It feels like drowning with your lungs still full of air.
language_patterns.purpose: 用母题意象的自相矛盾变体做情绪判词

language_patterns.formula: You are a ghost haunting your own family through a screen.
language_patterns.purpose: 把现代行为重命名为古老恐怖角色

language_patterns.formula: It is never the big thing that undoes them. It is always some small thing instead.
language_patterns.purpose: 用大小反转给出宿命感规则

language_patterns.formula: Bankruptcy would have been an option. A second job would have been an option.
language_patterns.purpose: 用排比列出被放弃的活路

language_patterns.formula: Somewhere right now another man is sitting at a kitchen table at 2:00 in the morning.

preferred_traits: 可拍照般具体的物件（red ink、hall light、duffel bag、locket）
家庭日常的最小动作（two stories instead of one、kiss goodbye）
法律/调查术语的克制挪用（pseudocide、death certificate、statute of limitations）
avoid_traits: 抽象大词与哲理化抒情
操作指南式的真实犯罪细节

forbidden_style.rule: 情绪必须用画面与事实承载，禁止形容词直给
重锤段落前后保持绝对严肃，不用幽默
规程保持抽象层级，不写成可操作犯罪指南
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把禁忌选择浪漫化为值得的结局

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
